div.head: II As Epilog
div.ab: Ealle ðis wæs gesetted on ðam miclan synoþ æt Greatanleage; on þam wæs se ærcebisceop Wulfhelme mid eallum þæm æþelum mannum ⁊ wiotan, ðe Æþelstan cyning [mihte] gegadrian.
Totum hoc institutum (et confirmatum) est in magna synodo apud Greateleyam, cui archiepiscopus Wulfhelmus interfuit et omnes optimates et sapientes quos Æþelstanus rex congregare potuit.
[Ealle ðis wæs gesetted on ðam miclan synoþ æt Greatanleage; on þam wæs se ærcebisceop Wulfhelme mid eallum þæm æþelum mannum ⁊ wiotan, ðe Æþelstan cyning mihte gegadrian.] [Ld]
All this was established at the great assembly at Grately, at which Archbishop Wulfhelm was present, with all the nobles and councillors whom King Æthelstan had assembled.
[All this was established at the great assembly at Grately, at which Archbishop Wulfhelm was present and all the nobles and councillors whom King Athelstan could gather together.]

(Epilog. All dies wurde festgesetzt auf der grossen Reichsversammlung zu Greatley; in ihr war der Erzbischof Wulfhelm mit all den adligen Männern und Witan, welche König Aethelstan versammeln konnte. Ld Quadr.)
(Epilogue. All this was established at the great assembly at Greatley; at it was Archbishop Wulfhelm with all the noble men and witan whom King Æthelstan could gather. Ld Quadr.)
div.note: Only in Ld and Quadr. Ld lacks ‘mihte’, which Liebermann supplies from Quadr. (cf. V As 4?). Schmid numbers the epilogue 26.3.

This is only in the Latin of Quadripartitus, but may come from a lost prologue to the code. Lambard translated the Latin into Old English. Athelstan’s other legislation refers several times to the laws promulgated at Grately.
